title: Preservation and right-adjoint existence for restricted integral compact support
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite-field datum D with l ≠ D.p, finite-type D.k-schemes X,Y and a separated finite-type D.k-morphism f:X→Y, without absolute separatedness. Let c be a compactification and E a finite coefficient extension [def-sf-ring-stage-assembly-data]. The actual ambient completed-coefficient compact-support functor sends the full complete constructible finite-Tor subcategory of X into that of Y, and its literal full-subcategory restriction is a left adjoint. No scalar, adjoint shift, realization, or coherence is supplied.

source.place: Construction 5.25 and Propositions 5.24 and 5.26; coefficient construction step 3

proof.text: Apply the preservation component and then the adjunction component under that preservation hypothesis. Pair their conclusions to obtain the existential preservation witness and the left-adjoint predicate for the literal lift.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_integral_support_adjoint (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (_hl : l ≠ D.p)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (c : Compactification f) (E : FieldStage.{u} l) :
    ∃ hpres : ∀ K : finiteTorConstructibleIntegralCategory l E.carrier X,
      finiteTorConstructibleIntegral l E.carrier Y
        ((PurCompactSupport.image (PurCompactSupport.completed l E.carrier) c).obj K.obj),
    ((finiteTorConstructibleIntegral l E.carrier Y).lift
      ((finiteTorConstructibleIntegral l E.carrier X).ι ⋙
        PurCompactSupport.image (PurCompactSupport.completed l E.carrier) c)
      hpres).IsLeftAdjoint
